required_caveats: Energy is vendor-estimated dynamic energy including common94FF fixture; not physical, static, board, memory or full-neuron energy.
GLIF activity is a bounded64-image distribution-gated capture, not full-test or full-stream energy.

Source queues, zero filtering, window endpoints and variable-consumption integration are outside counted core resources.

Exact packing preserves the declared integer neuron; FP32 conversion can change predictions; no packing accuracy gain.
OTTTbeta128 shift wins energy; BNTTbeta253 exact shift/add hardware is unmeasured; AdEx is unvalidated.

conditional_paper_verdict: The final evidence supports one focused exact membrane-leakage primitive contribution: compact signed rounded decoding combined with real range-selected pair/full execution at fixed signed16 precision, and measured resource/rate/estimated-energy trade-offs. E4 closes the equal-one-DSP comparison with 12.37% lower estimated GLIF energy and fewer issues at added fabric; E3 preserves a two-DSP competing point near energy parity. This is credible material for an ISCAS primitive paper, not demonstrated universal superiority or a guaranteed strong-publication result. Generic value adaptation and fixed splitting are prior art; constant-specialized model hardware, external source integration, three unavailable full methods and failed E2 evidence remain explicit limits.
